sentences.text: Use `kubectl drain` to safely evict all pods from the node while respecting any PodDisruptionBudgets, and after maintenance run `kubectl uncordon <node name>` to resume scheduling.

citations.quote: You can use `kubectl drain` to safely evict all of your pods from a node ... will respect the PodDisruptionBudgets you have specified.

If you leave the node in the cluster during the maintenance operation, you need to run

```shell
kubectl uncordon <node name>
```
